lv3.perQuality: 4 per quality would need 4/4 for 80%, contradicting 22/24

rules.pass: overall >= pass AND every quality block >= perQuality.min/perQuality.of; no averaging across qualities
rules.speed: only the Lv3 name-recall level; 80% of *correct* attempts must complete within 3000 ms; device-invalid trials are excluded
rules.delay: a different day (>= 24h and >= 12h apart is not enough alone); the delayed set uses items not in the same-day set
rules.hint: an audition/name hint marks the trial assisted; it counts as practice success, never as an independent confirmation
rules.selfCheck: MIDI confirmation and self-confirmation are stored as different evidence; self-confirmation never promotes to MIDI-verified
rules.duplicate: the delayed set uses different (quality, root) cells than the same-day set where the level has enough cells; a same-day repeat is counted once toward coverage
rules.invalid: disconnected / prepare-failed / clock-jump / capability trials are excluded from every denominator, recorded with their reason
rules.noInput: no captured notes within 1500 ms is an attempt with result no-input, never a wrong answer or a device-invalid

answerPolicy.nameRecall: required quality tones with the source voicing's bass; omissions/tensions follow the course recipe, never a single fixed MIDI set
answerPolicy.savedVoicing: the authored notes are the gold; no theory-derived additions
answerPolicy.ear: accepted harmony + specified bass; exact voicing is a separate labelled policy
